title_zh: 电竞比赛与狂热的粉丝文化
note_en: The 比 comparison has a fixed order: subject + 比 + what it's compared to + (还/更) + adjective, as in 气氛比很多体育比赛还要热烈 "the atmosphere was even more electric than at many sporting events." English puts the adjective first ("more electric than"), but Chinese saves it for the end; 还要 or 更 before the adjective adds "even." The text repeats the pattern in 淘汰率比很多人想象的还要高 "the dropout rate is even higher than many people imagine."
